messages:
paul-fin: Heads-up: Customer Meridian (acct 3310) reported receiving two invoice emails both labeled INV-2026-11-03-3310 but with different totals. One includes a shipping_discount line (total=9,450 cents), the other omits it (total=9,750 cents). Both PDFs delivered.

rebecca-billing: I see the duplicate in the send logs. renderer logged two successful writes for invoice_id INV-2026-11-03-3310 at 11:06 and 11:07. The first write included shipping_discount; the second write re-rendered after template fallback and the discount variable resolved to null so line omitted. Both writes produced separate PDFs and mailer sent both.

send-bot: mailer: message_id=msg_77a sent recipients=acct-3310 email=acct-3310@meridian.co attachments=[INV-2026-11-03-3310-v1.pdf]

send-bot: mailer: message_id=msg_77b sent recipients=acct-3310 email=acct-3310@meridian.co attachments=[INV-2026-11-03-3310-v2.pdf]

jake-ops: Quick theory: template renderer has a two-stage fallback: it attempts personalized discount merge from discounts-service; if merge fails it falls back to a global-empty template and retries render. The retry path currently doesn't consult previously rendered invoice_lines and will commit a new invoice snapshot even when invoice_id is identical. Also mailer will send any new PDF variants.

rebecca-billing: SQL to verify both writes and the shipping_discount presence:
```
SELECT id, invoice_id, total_cents, metadata->>'shipping_discount_applied' as discount_flag, created_at
FROM invoices
WHERE account_id = 3310 AND batch_date = '2026-11-03'
ORDER BY created_at;
```

paul-fin: Customer paid the higher total (payment_id=pay_m11b at 11:20). They were charged the amount without discount. We need to issue a credit for the missing discount and ensure only one invoice shows in customer portal. Finance signoff?

cfo-elaine: Approve credit memo for the delta and cover processing fees. Please include a short CS note. Finance to be CC'd.

jake-ops: Proposed remediation: 1) stop automatic resend on retry until idempotency guard deployed, 2) add renderer idempotency: if invoice_id exists, perform reconciliation of invoice_lines instead of writing a new snapshot, 3) change mailer to dedupe outgoing attachments by invoice_id within a short window, 4) backfill discount value for the affected invoice and re-render with `--use-existing-lines` flag and `--suppress-email` initially.

rebecca-billing: I'll queue a backfill and a suppressed re-render so we can produce a corrected PDF and issue credit memo. Also adding a smoke rule: detect >1 PDF objects in S3 for same invoice_id within 1h and alert.

send-bot: manual-regenerate queued: job=regen-2026-11-03-3310 requested_by=rebecca-billing ETA=2m (email suppressed)

send-bot: regeneration completed: job=regen-2026-11-03-3310 status=completed results: invoice corrected, pdfs_replaced=true, credit_memo=CM-2026-11-03-3310 amount=300 cents processed=true

paul-fin: Confirmed credit memo created for delta (300 cents) plus processing-fee coverage. CS notified and will send customer note.

rebecca-billing: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/p/billing/+/6789  adds renderer idempotency guard and mailer dedupe by invoice_id; includes unit tests for discount merge fallback. Planning hotfix deploy after staging.

jake-ops: Also adding a short-lived feature flag to prevent automatic email resend on renderer retries until the guard is in prod.

cso-rachel: (cc) Drafted customer message: "We're sorry — a rendering race caused two invoice versions to be sent. We've issued a credit for the difference and corrected the invoice in your portal. Apologies for the confusion." Will send once credit memo number confirmed.

paul-fin: Filing FIN-INV-440 for postmortem and P&L impact. Thanks all, closing loop once deploy goes green.
